citizen_question: My son got 74.6% in Class 12 and has joined B.Com. Can he get the Medhavi award? It is almost 75%.
resolution: Sorry, he is not eligible. Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan Yojana needs 75% or more in Class 12, and marks are not rounded up. A score of 74.6% is below the limit. The service centre or the SchemeSathi assistant can help you check whether he qualifies for any other scheme.
